notes.title: UI Overhaul | Patch 0.8.15
notes.content:
This patch has a massive update for basically all UI elements in the game. We want to move away from the "mobile" look and reduced and re-balanced the font sizes to target the desktop experience. Which, in the end, is what this build is made for.

Additionally, the tutorial has more visual aid and some updates in general for the racers in terms of speed balancing in relation to each other.

Cheers,
your StarBoost Team

notes.title: Patch - Build 0.8.101
notes.content:
[h2]Sunday Evening Patch[/h2]

We just pushed a patch that[b] fixes a crucial step in during the tutorial:[/b] 
[list]
[*] the Strafing part was broken and led to not being able to strafe for extended periods - fixed!
[/list]
Enjoy the rest of the playtest and please don't forget you help us out tremendously by letting us know your opinion & impression of the game. You can use the feedback button directly in the main menu for it.

Cheers

notes.title: Adrenalin & Orientation - Patch 0.8.99
notes.content:
We received some feedback on racing on streets and that there are situation where you cannot see ahead too well - especially in loopings. So we implemented a camera tilting with the input when docked on streets. That was not possible before, let's see if that makes it more comfortable.

In addition:
Boosting has more impact now. You know it when you see it ;)

notes.title: Patch 0.8.98
notes.content:
We received some super helpful feedback, so we implemented and updated the game immediately!

[b][NEW][/b]
[list]
[*] Strafing now has a rolling effect - making the racing more responsive and dynamic
[*] Jumping has similar animations
[*] The Asteroid Breaker Rocket has some internal changes + can blast away enemies and competition
[/list]

[b][Fixes][/b]
[list]
[*] Music not playing the first loop
[/list]

Happy Racing and Blasting and otherwise: 
Enjoy the Weekend!

notes.title: Update - Build 0.8.95
notes.content:
[h2]New Additions this time[/h2]

We added a nice rolling to the racer when strafing. This makes it clearer when the action is triggered and overall a better feature. AND it looks very nice - at least in our opinion!

And we have something explosive in this patch:
[b]the ASTEROID BREAKER[/b] - a rocket that's now enabled on all racers from the beginning.
[i]Use it to get out of clutch situations or simplaywhen you feel like it.[/i]

Cheers,
your StarBoost Team

notes.title: Patch - Build 0.8.91
notes.content: Just a quick update today: fixing an Event / Progression notification playing on every restart of the game

notes.title: PATCHLOG Build 0.8.88
notes.content:
After receiving some great feedback we could directly take action and implement the aspects which seemed to be the most irritating for new players. The key issue seems to be gamepad controls, which are now adjusted and the camera is much more stable. Also the boost was mentioned to be not impactful enough, which is now more powerful, even with the first racers.

In addition the vertical strafing seems to be too much complexity and does not add great advantages - so we cut it out for now. While it is a bit more limiting in the maneuverability, the steering and overall controls feel more balanced and more predictable in general

[KEY POINTS]
[list]
[*] Input for gamepad updated: camera no longer counter rotating / simulating drift. 
[*] Input more snappy - less delay.
[*] Controls also behave a bit less jumpy now - smoother and scaled to movement
[/list]
[BALANCING]
[list]
[*] First Racer are faster and have stronger Boost Power
[/list]

[MISC]
[list]
[*] New Strafing sound when playing with gamepad
[*] New helper icons for keys during tutorial
[*] General boost feedback improved
[*] More vfx feedback on point collect
[*] Tutorial Race updated to match new strafing
[*] Menu sounds updated
[/list]
[FIXES]
[list]
[*] Menu sound not playing first music loop
[*] Camera snapping to racer on first item in main menu
[/list]
